0022600188.text: The Golden State Warriors (5-3, on a five-game winning streak and 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back) host the Miami Heat (2-5, coming off a loss and 4th in the Southeast, 2 games back) in this ninth game of the Warriors' season, with Golden State 3-1 at home. Golden State will be without Gui Santos, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, and Moses Moody, who are all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and their last meeting was a 135-112 Warriors win in San Francisco on January 19, 2026.
